desc:
🎉 PARTYBOX 2 IS HERE

Grab your friends, pick a game, and let the room decide who's actually funny.

🎮 NINE GAMES, ONE HUB
QuipClash 2, Real Ones, Imposter, Chain Gang, All In, Problem Solvers, Hot Potato, and Chess + Checkers for when you need to settle something quietly.

🎨 YOUR GUY, YOUR WAY
Unlock fits, colors and accessories in the locker. Everything you earn shows up in the lobby and on the podium.

🎵 MUSIC KITS
Host picks the music. Your kit plays in the lobby for the whole room to hear.

🚪 ROOMS
Private lobby with a 4 letter code, or jump into a public one and meet whoever's in there. Host runs the settings.

🎊 CONFETTI
Earn it for answering, voting, winning and placing. Spend it on everything above.

🔥 Limited time events and a new game every week.

📱 Phone, PC and console.

Bring friends. It's twice as good with a full room.
